text:
carmen: who packed extra adaptors for the EU->US weird plugs? asking for a friend.
ben: me. bought a tiny 3-in-1 world adapter at the airport kiosk. lifesaver at the hotel lobby.
sylvie: Pro tip: small multi-adapter + a short extension cable = shareable charging station in rooms.
trent: Also bring a printed tiny note with phone numbers + flight # for hotel laundry tags. Lost tags = laundry gone. learned the hard way. :grimacing:
luca: For posters/rollups: a sleeve tube with a strap fits under the plane seat if soft. airline staff were chill about it.
travel-gf-bot: FYI: If you check an extra bag due to conference materials, mark it as "work materials" on the travel form to speed reimbursement.
carmen: Quick poll: would you prefer 1) communal charging station in each room 2) everyone bring own adapter 3) borrow from front desk? react 1/2/3
sylvie: 1 — communal station. reduces duplicates and fits everyone's dongles.
ben: 2 from me if youre in different timezones and need overnight charge.
luca: I can bring 2 short strips for communal use if needed. lightweight.
trent: Also: tiny label maker or sharpie to mark chargers. prevents the mystery-device swap.
carmen: I'll add a short "plug + charging" section to the offsite doc with a checklist and I'll note who can bring strips. thanks all!
